title: Lifecycle V3.1 task summary (read contract for the Milestone Manager)
description: Ownership split. Lifecycle V3.1 owns task execution state: task ids, task context and evidence, execution transitions, review and acceptance gates, checkpoints, leases and recovery. The Milestone Manager owns the milestone registry, roadmap, dependencies, owner decisions and high-level development state. The ledger stores milestone_ref as an opaque string it never interprets or validates against a registry; the Milestone Manager never writes task state. The Milestone Manager reads task summaries with `python -m scripts.dev_workflow.task_ledger summary --milestone <ref> --json` (or task_ledger.Ledger.summaries(milestone_ref)), which return an array of objects matching this schema. Additive fields may appear; consumers must ignore unknown fields. A breaking change bumps the $id version.

milestone_ref.description: Opaque reference owned by the Milestone Manager (e.g. its milestone id). Null when the task is not attached to a milestone.

last_verified_commit.description: Latest commit with a recorded passing test/gate result.

accepted_commit.description: Commit an independent review accepted. Null unless status is ACCEPTED or INTEGRATED.

v3_runs.description: Linked Lifecycle V3 run state directories.
